notes.title: Custom Recipes Major Update V1.2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello, Baristas!

Major Update for Barista Simulator Now Live!

The update we've been working on for a long time is finally here! With this update, we're refreshing your coffee brewing experience and taking the game to the next level. Here's what awaits you:

Patch Notes 1.2.0.0

New Features:

Custom Recipe System: You can now create your own custom recipes! Use different ingredients and cup sizes to craft unique coffee recipes. Blend your espresso, water, milk, and many other ingredients to create your signature coffee.

Café Menu Customization: With the new café menu system, you can add or remove coffee options from your menu. This feature allows you to easily manage prices and apply discounts or price increases.

Recipe Price Customization: Adjust coffee prices up or down by up to 25% based on the difficulty and ingredients used. Tailor the prices of unique items like frappes to fit your sales strategy.

Sticky Notes: By popular demand from baristas, you can now focus solely on coffee-making. With the new recipe pinning system, you can view complex recipes, like Shakerato, easily from the bottom right corner of the screen while preparing them.

Improvements:

Enhanced AI Behavior: Baristas will no longer use machines you have restricted, creating a more organized workflow in your café.

Interface Enhancements: Improvements have been made to the menu system and user interface.

Improved Lighting: Lighting has been enhanced for a better visual experience.

Machine and General Bug Fixes: Issues with machines and gameplay-affecting bugs have been resolved.

We continue to improve our game by taking your feedback into account. Now, it's time to dive back into your café and explore these new features!

Happy brewing!

The CubeCube Sports LTD Team.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Dear valued café owners,

We are thrilled to announce that after an incredible journey of 1.5 years of development and 6 months in the early access stage, Barista Simulator is now ready for its highly anticipated 1.0 version release. As a small but passionate team of two, we have poured our hearts and souls into creating an immersive coffee shop simulation experience that meets the desires and expectations of our beloved players.

Throughout this entire process, your feedback has been invaluable to us. We carefully listened to your suggestions and ideas, and we are proud to say that many of the features you desired have been incorporated into the game. Your voices have guided us, shaping the direction and evolution of Barista Simulator, and we cannot thank you enough for your unwavering support and valuable input.

With version 1.0, we mark the culmination of our efforts in the early access stage. However, this does not mean that the journey ends here. We remain committed to providing ongoing updates to enhance your coffee shop experience. Our development pipeline is bursting with exciting plans, including the introduction of new machines, customized recipes, ne café environments, and a plethora of decorative updates. Our dedication to making Barista Simulator the ultimate coffee brewing and serving adventure remains as strong as ever.

To ensure that you stay up-to-date on all the latest news and developments, we have established a dedicated Twitter account. Follow us on Twitter for regular updates, sneak peeks behind the scenes, and exclusive content. Your continued support and engagement mean the world to us, and we can't wait to share the next phase of this incredible journey with you.

Once again, thank you for being an integral part of the Barista Simulator community. Together, we have created something truly special.

Warm regards,
Dev Team

notes.title: V0.6.0 Major Content Update - IceAge - Roadmap Level 1
notes.content:
Hello dear baristas,

As a first stage of Early Access, this update consists of new machines, new recipes, bug fixes and many improvements. With the new blenders and shakers now you baristas can prepare 7 new recipes which are shakeratos and frappes. We also added some of the most wanted features. 

Now you can customize the menu of your cafe and choose which recipes to sell. This allows every barista to choose which coffee to sell and have a better gaming experience. 

With the new controller support and keybinding system, you can enjoy being a barista with different controls and controllers. 

And now you don’t have to remember and recheck recipes regularly. The recipe that you viewed will be written on a sticky note near the recipe book. 

Now you can take 3 customers order at the same time. With this feature you baristas can prepare more than one order. 

Our goal is to add new content and improve the gameplay with the community's feedback. Now we move to the next big extension of Barista Simulator; Staff Update. If you like to be part of the community and development process join our Discord Channel.

https://discord.gg/PBA8PgTHJh

Regards,
Devs
